packageRules.description: RDF4J server-image major bumps change the LMDB store format and require stopping the stack, wiping the stores, and a full re-ingest (see docker-compose.yml); hold within 6.x so a major never lands as a routine dependency bump
The rdf4j client libraries stay on 5.x for now: 6.x requires the Jakarta/Java-25 migration, while REST protocol 12 keeps the 5.3.x client compatible with the 6.x server
Updates to the parent dependencies should trigger a new patch release
Updates to the dependencies under the build settings element should not trigger any release
Updates to the dependencies with scope 'test' should be tagged as 'test(deps)'
Updates to the dependencies defined in package.json should be tagged as 'build(deps)'
